mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, username, action, module, target_id, target_type, detail, ip, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{module}, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{detail}, #{ip}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
